feature_definition: bin j = sum of processed intensities with 2000.0 + j*3.0 <= m/z < 2000.0 + (j+1)*3.0 (last bin includes 20000.0)

exclusion_reason_definitions.missing_code: metadata row has no spectrum code
exclusion_reason_definitions.antibiotic_not_reported: the site's metadata has no column for the antibiotic
exclusion_reason_definitions.ambiguous_ast_result: result that is not a single category, e.g. 'R(1), S(1)'
exclusion_reason_definitions.unsupported_ast_result: value other than R, I, S or a known ambiguous form
exclusion_reason_definitions.excluded_workstation: sample type listed in dataset.exclude_workstations (e.g. HospitalHygiene)
exclusion_reason_definitions.missing_acquisition_date: no parseable acquisition_date while dataset.require_acquisition_date is true
exclusion_reason_definitions.conflicting_duplicate_record: spectrum code listed more than once at the site with different labels (all copies excluded)
exclusion_reason_definitions.duplicate_record: spectrum code listed more than once at the site with the same label (first usable row kept)
exclusion_reason_definitions.no_spectrum_file: raw spectrum file not found on disk
exclusion_reason_definitions.malformed_spectrum: raw spectrum file unreadable or failed validation
exclusion_reason_definitions.unusable_spectrum: spectrum readable but preprocessing left no usable signal
exclusion_reason_definitions.differs_from_driams_binned: processed raw file does not match the published DRIAMS binned_6000 file for the same code (the two files hold different measurements)
exclusion_reason_definitions.duplicate_spectrum: processed features identical to an earlier sample (first kept)

notes: patient_no is re-hashed for every DRIAMS-A year folder: patient groups are only valid within a year, so the same person appearing in two years cannot be detected.
Sites without patient IDs (DRIAMS-B, DRIAMS-D) treat every spectrum as its own group, so repeated isolates of one patient there cannot be detected.
Sites without a workstation column (DRIAMS-B, DRIAMS-D) cannot be filtered for hospital-hygiene samples.
Intermediate (I) results are handled as: resistant.
Only stateless preprocessing is applied; no scaling, PCA or feature selection is fitted here.
